stuck_event_definition: Less than 0.05 units net 3D displacement over each nonoverlapping 20-action (two-second) window; repeated windows are not distinct incidents.
sustained_requested_low_motion_definitio: Existing environment counter: movement requested and position stays within 0.05 horizontal units of the anchor for at least 20 consecutive actions; steps count once threshold is reached.
low_motion_definition: Less than 0.02 horizontal units displaced per action, not necessarily fully immobile.
